concerns.text: Phase 11 (Linting & Validation) is listed in the implementation phases but is not linked to any Functional Requirement (FR) or Success Criterion (SC) in the specification. The spec does not mandate linting as a functional deliverable, so this plan element is over‑reach.
Phase 12 (Quickstart Validation) appears without any associated FR or SC. The specification does not require a quickstart validation step, making this an unanchored plan element.

Phase 13 (Specification Update) is included in the plan but has no corresponding FR or SC in the spec. Updating the spec is a project‑management activity, not a functional requirement, thus this is over‑reach.
